Company description: COP (Generated via gemini-3.1-flash-lite)

ConocoPhillips (COP) is a leading global independent exploration and production company headquartered in Houston, Texas. The firm focuses on the discovery, development, and extraction of crude oil, natural gas, and liquefied natural gas across diverse international assets, including significant operations in the United States, Norway, Canada, and the Asia-Pacific region. 

The company’s modern identity was established in 2002 through the merger of Conoco Inc. and Phillips Petroleum Company, two entities with deep roots in the American energy industry dating back to the early 20th century. Following a major strategic shift in 2012, ConocoPhillips spun off its downstream and midstream operations into a separate entity, Phillips 66, allowing the parent company to concentrate exclusively on upstream exploration and production. Today, ConocoPhillips is recognized for its disciplined capital allocation, commitment to operational efficiency, and a strategic emphasis on low-cost-of-supply assets, positioning it as one of the largest pure-play exploration and production companies in the world.
